name: Great Healing Potion
author: vkays
description: Adds a brand-new consumable item, Great Healing (Inventory/Inventory Additions/Miscellaneous/Potions/Great Healing), with its own newly-authored icon art (a gold/amber recolor of the potion flask, hand-decoded and re-encoded from the game's own sprite format via reverse-engineering -- see mdl16_format.py). Heals more than Extra Healing and removes critical hits. Requires the test-pocket mod to also be enabled (adds one more chest reward action to its Test Pocket.zax, on top of the necklace) -- open Lucia's chest in the Test Pocket to receive one.
